html:
Gaborone, the capital of Botswana, was built from 1964 as a new planned capital for the independent state, because the colonial government had been run from Mafeking in South Africa.

The site, near the old village of Chief Gaborone and a reliable water supply, was chosen for its location near the railway. Buildings went up in time for independence in 1966, when it was a small town of a few thousand people.

It grew fast with diamond wealth and is now home to a large share of the population, the seat of government, the university and the headquarters of the Southern African Development Community. It replaced the protectorate capital and is a symbol of Botswana's independent path.
sum: Gaborone, the capital of Botswana, was built from 1964 as a new planned capital for the independent state, because the colonial government had been run from Mafeking in South Africa.
